page_annotations: This is a verso facing fol. 268. Most lines are extra-detail notes keyed by arrows to the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa and Śatakatraya entries on fol. 268.
The strip beyond the gutter (x>~3160) shows facing-page fragments: shelfmarks, ticks and 'See Bṛhadāraṇyaka...'. These are excluded from transcription.
Non-text marks: a small ink dot at about (550,1110), a stitch hole at the gutter, and a left-edge vertical stroke at about (295,4020).
Blank stretches between b002 and b003 and below b014 were inspected and contain no text.
unresolved_relationships: The attachment of b004 to the struck 'Śatacaṇḍī sahasracaṇḍī prayoga' entry on fol. 268 is uncertain.
b008 and b014 have no arrows, so their targets are inferred from height alignment only.

coverage.finding: The pencil folio number '267b.' is in the top-left corner with a superscript b. The candidate records it correctly.

The text matches the source, and the cancellation inside the parenthesis is kept. The letter after '(' in '(n. 21, 22, 23)' is n-like or m-like; compare the '(m. 17-23)' form in b005. The arrow at the right is at about native y 650, level with ←✓c. 186(1) on fol. 268.
This is a one-line note directly above b004, with 'author' squeezed small at the gutter edge. The ampersand is v-like. The attachment to b004 is plausible but not certain.

This is a ticked holding with its own shelfmark. The cancelled opening of line 2 is illegible; it may begin with 'ff'. 'n.d. : 12 : 13/14 : D.' stands on the same baseline as ', 12 ff. in two hands. Lz. 1305.', to the right (about native y 1990), so the candidate's single-line literal is consistent.

Arrow tails cross the gutter. The arrow heads for b012 and b013 lie beyond it, so their ownership is ambiguous. The arrows link to fol. 268 rows by height only; these are probable links, not resolved parents.

region_review.middle: b003 to b011 are all represented. There is a stitch hole at the gutter at about y 2600 and another near y 3460.
region_review.bottom: b012 to b014 are present. Below about y 4160 the page is blank to the lower edge.
region_review.left_margin: There is a vertical stroke at the page edge at about x 295, y 4020-4130 beside b014. No other text.
region_review.right_margin: Arrows sit at the gutter. The fragments of the facing page are excluded.
region_review.interlinear: The only interlinear-like item is the second line of b010 ('with RV, i, 35, 2'). There are no other insertions.
